facts.text: Under the Lifetime Guarantee, graduates of Trine's Angola campus can return at any time to take seated undergraduate courses on campus for free without earning credit.

sources.title: Lifetime Guarantee Program | Trine University
sources.quote: As a graduate of Trine University's Angola campus, you are welcome to return at any time to enroll in seated undergraduate courses on the Angola campus — at no cost* and for no credit.

facts.text: Trine's Lifetime Guarantee scholarship increases merit awards by $500 for students completing 32 credits in their first year with at least a 2.75 GPA.

sources.title: Lifetime Guarantee Program | Trine University
sources.quote: Complete at least 32 credits in your first year with a minimum GPA of 2.75, and your merit award will increase by $500.
